# Burning Springs: Quest Rewards and Checklist

*****Subject to change pending porting to live servers*****

__Welcoming Committee__

**How to start the quest**

- Tune your Pip-Boy radio to the Ohio Distress Broadcast.

**Notes**

- You’ll run into two separate enemy waves during the questline. If you’re not geared for combat, the quest takes place inside an instance, so you can bring someone with you as long as you’re the team leader.
- +8 Charisma SPECIAL check

**Rewards**

• 1000 XP

• 100 Caps

• Aid item

• Ammo

• Random armor piece

• Random weapon

• Random plan

**Plan:** Welcome to Ohio Sign

- Non-Tradeable

**Plan:** Rust Raider Light Outfit

- Non-Tradeable
- Crafted outfits can not be dropped

__Might Makes Right__

**How to start the quest**

- After finishing Welcoming Committee, this quest starts automatically and sends you to Highway Town.

**Notes**

• Complete 3 Test of Might challenges

• Complete 4 Test of Dominance challenges

**Rewards**

• 800 XP

• 800 Caps

• 1 to 3 Legendary Modules

• Treasury Notes

• Rad-X

• Stimpaks

• Ammo

**Plan:** Highway Town Chems Store Sign

- Non-Tradeable

**Plan:** Rust Raider Medium Outfit

- Non-Tradeable
- Crafted outfits can not be dropped

__Insurrection__

**How to start the quest**

- After completing Might Makes Right, this quest starts automatically.

**Notes**

• +8 Charisma SPECIAL check

• +8 Strength SPECIAL check

• Requires Lockpick and Hacker perk cards for optional interactions

• Magpie dislikes violence, so keep dialogue choices in mind

**Rewards**

• 1250 XP

• 150 Caps

• Aid item

• Ammo

• Random armor piece

• Random weapon

• Random plan

**Plan:** Mounted Deathclaw Matriarch Head

- Non-Tradeable

**Plan:** Rust Raider Heavy Outfit

- Non-Tradeable
- Crafted outfits can not be dropped

__When the Rust Settles__

**How to start the quest:**

- After completing Insurrection, this quest starts automatically.

**Notes**

- You’ll need to fight 4 waves of enemies during this quest. If you’re not set up for combat, the quest is inside an instance, so you can bring someone with you as long as you’re the team leader.

**Rewards**

• 1600 XP

• 165 Caps

• Aid item

• Ammo

• Random armor piece

• Random weapon

• Random plan

**Plan:** The Rust King's Throne

__Checklist__

**Your progress will be automatically saved as you mark the boxes on the checklist below.**

**Other Guides**

I'm an Aussie data miner who creates guides for farming, events, and food buffs in Fallout 76.

I firmly believe that knowledge should be accessible to everyone, so my guides will always be free. However, maintaining a website and using photo and video editing software can be costly.

- __Follow Me on Social Media:__ Keep up with my latest updates by following me on social media.

- __One-Time Donation:__ Buy me a coffee.

- __Monthly Contribution:__ Become a regular supporter by subscribing to my Ko-fi page.

Every bit of support helps cover the costs of creating these guides and maybe even gets me a cup of coffee or three;)
